topics.text:
us carries out new strike wave against iran as tehran hits sites in jordan
centcom said us forces struck dozens of irgc targets in iran over roughly two hours. the strikes followed iranian missile fire at us sites in jordan, after which president trump vowed a hard american response. bombing resumed at around 8 p.m. eastern time.

topics.headline: Alex Jones calls for Trump's removal over the Iran war
topics.snippet: Alex Jones, formerly of InfoWars and a prominent Trump supporter through the 2024 election, called for the president's impeachment or removal under the 25th Amendment. He said Trump is out of control…
topics.text:
alex jones calls for trump's removal over the iran war
alex jones, formerly of infowars and a prominent trump supporter through the 2024 election, called for the president's impeachment or removal under the 25th amendment. he said trump is out of control on iran and has not obtained congressional authorization for the war, and pointed to talk of a national draft. the break marks one of the sharpest defections among trump's long-standing allies.

topics.headline: Todd Blanche's attorney general confirmation vote postponed for lack of votes
topics.snippet: A Senate Judiciary Committee vote on Todd Blanche's nomination to be attorney general was postponed indefinitely after it became clear he lacked support. Republican senators John Cornyn and Thom Tilli…
topics.text:
todd blanche's attorney general confirmation vote postponed for lack of votes
a senate judiciary committee vote on todd blanche's nomination to be attorney general was postponed indefinitely after it became clear he lacked support. republican senators john cornyn and thom tillis are holdouts, with cornyn cancelling a meeting with blanche over a weaponization fund and saying blanche had not done enough. epstein survivors spent the day on capitol hill delivering binders of epstein documents to senate offices.

topics.headline: DOJ hands unredacted Epstein records to federal judge under court order
topics.snippet: The Department of Justice turned over unredacted Epstein-related records to Judge Emmet Sullivan by a 3 p.m. deadline, complying with an order that followed a lawsuit brought by Katie Phang. Sullivan…
topics.text:
doj hands unredacted epstein records to federal judge under court order
the department of justice turned over unredacted epstein-related records to judge emmet sullivan by a 3 p.m. deadline, complying with an order that followed a lawsuit brought by katie phang. sullivan will review the material in camera to determine what can be released publicly without exposing victim-identifying information. the doj says the documents contain victim-related material, but has not published the redaction log required by the epstein files transparency act.

topics.headline: Hegseth meets Netanyahu one-on-one as three Iran options are weighed
topics.snippet: Secretary of War Pete Hegseth met directly with Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and envoys from both sides, a meeting critics say breaks with the convention that heads of state meet only counterpart…
topics.text:
hegseth meets netanyahu one-on-one as three iran options are weighed
secretary of war pete hegseth met directly with prime minister benjamin netanyahu and envoys from both sides, a meeting critics say breaks with the convention that heads of state meet only counterparts or the secretary of state. separately, a senior israeli official said trump and netanyahu are weighing three paths on iran's nuclear program: a deal, a blockade paired with economic pressure, or a massive strike. photographs of the meeting were posted to hegseth's own account.

topics.headline: Russian overnight barrage kills civilians in Kyiv and Lviv
topics.snippet: Ukraine said Russian overnight strikes involving more than 70 missiles and roughly 280 drones killed at least six people, including children, with Kyiv and Lviv the main targets and dozens injured. Po…
topics.text:
russian overnight barrage kills civilians in kyiv and lviv
ukraine said russian overnight strikes involving more than 70 missiles and roughly 280 drones killed at least six people, including children, with kyiv and lviv the main targets and dozens injured. poland scrambled jets after a russian missile crossed into its airspace. a record 56,000 people sheltered in kyiv's metro in one night, and officials say shelter gaps leave many residents with few options. russia said its strikes hit ukrainian factories and three cargo ships, a claim reuters could not verify, while a ukrainian military official said russia likely used a north korean missile near kryvyi rih for the first time in nearly a year.

topics.headline: Senate lacks the votes to pass Trump's Save America Act
topics.snippet: Majority Leader John Thune said the Senate does not have the votes to pass the Save America Act, contradicting Trump's claim that the support is there. Thune said his math differs from the White House…
topics.text:
senate lacks the votes to pass trump's save america act
majority leader john thune said the senate does not have the votes to pass the save america act, contradicting trump's claim that the support is there. thune said his math differs from the white house's. republicans also lack the votes to end the filibuster for the bill and may attempt to move parts of it through reconciliation, though the senate parliamentarian has already ruled against that route.

topics.headline: Trump administration seeks AI tools for pre-crime policing
topics.snippet: The administration is seeking AI systems to analyse government data on private citizens and flag Americans before they act, first reported by Reason. The FBI's Terrorist Screening Center, which mainta…
topics.text:
trump administration seeks ai tools for pre-crime policing
the administration is seeking ai systems to analyse government data on private citizens and flag americans before they act, first reported by reason. the fbi's terrorist screening center, which maintains the terrorist watch list, is the office pursuing the tool. the center has broadened the threat categories it monitors to include anti-christianity, anti-capitalism, anti-americanism, extremism on migration, race and gender, and hostility toward traditional views on family, religion and morality.

topics.headline: DOJ sues Utah lieutenant governor over refusal to hand over voter file
topics.snippet: Lt. Gov. Deidre Henderson, a Republican, has refused to give the Trump administration Utah's entire unredacted voter file, which includes birthdates, partial Social Security numbers and driver licence…
topics.text:
doj sues utah lieutenant governor over refusal to hand over voter file
lt. gov. deidre henderson, a republican, has refused to give the trump administration utah's entire unredacted voter file, which includes birthdates, partial social security numbers and driver licence numbers for more than two million people. the justice department sued her and sent a letter warning of possible criminal penalties, after homeland security secretary markwayne mullin threatened state election officials with prison time. a may audit of 2,069,640 records found 99.72 percent were verifiable citizens, with 27 alleged and 25 probable noncitizens. the doj has also asked the supreme court to let trump's executive order on mail voting take effect before the midterms.

topics.headline: Musk revives America PAC to spend heavily in the midterms
topics.snippet: Axios reports Elon Musk is planning to put tens of millions and possibly hundreds of millions of dollars into the midterm elections to help Republicans up and down the ballot. He is reviving America P…
topics.text:
musk revives america pac to spend heavily in the midterms
axios reports elon musk is planning to put tens of millions and possibly hundreds of millions of dollars into the midterm elections to help republicans up and down the ballot. he is reviving america pac, which spent more than $260 million in 2024, with a focus on digital ads and direct mail to boost republican turnout. musk and the pac were previously referred for possible criminal prosecution in wisconsin over the 2025 state supreme court election.

topics.headline: Fauci invokes the Fifth Amendment at Senate hearing
topics.snippet: Dr. Anthony Fauci repeatedly invoked his Fifth Amendment right against self-incrimination while testifying under oath before Sen. Rand Paul's Senate committee. Republican senators including Josh Hawle…
topics.text:
fauci invokes the fifth amendment at senate hearing
dr. anthony fauci repeatedly invoked his fifth amendment right against self-incrimination while testifying under oath before sen. rand paul's senate committee. republican senators including josh hawley said the move indicated he had something to hide, while others noted trump invoked the fifth nearly 450 times in the new york attorney general's civil probe of his business practices. fauci's defenders said the assertion was made to avoid a perjury trap and that fauci, as an adviser, had no authority to implement policy. asked about a pardon fauci received from president biden, trump questioned whether biden had personally signed it or used an autopen.

topics.headline: McConnell's office stonewalls questions about his absence and a signature
topics.snippet: Sen. Mitch McConnell has not appeared on video in over a month and his staff has declined to answer questions about it or say whether a video is coming. A July 28 letter on federal disaster relief for…
topics.text:
mcconnell's office stonewalls questions about his absence and a signature
sen. mitch mcconnell has not appeared on video in over a month and his staff has declined to answer questions about it or say whether a video is coming. a july 28 letter on federal disaster relief for kentucky carries a signature that differs markedly from scanned wet signatures on his two previous letters, suggesting an autopen or digital generation was used. mcconnell was discharged from hospital care and is currently in a rehabilitation facility.

topics.headline: Indiana data center construction cut power to tornado warning sirens
topics.snippet: A data center under construction in Linton County, Indiana cut the power line feeding the county's tornado warning sirens ahead of severe storms, according to Linton News. The sirens were inoperable f…
topics.text:
indiana data center construction cut power to tornado warning sirens
a data center under construction in linton county, indiana cut the power line feeding the county's tornado warning sirens ahead of severe storms, according to linton news. the sirens were inoperable for a period, though residents could still receive alerts by phone and online. residents have criticised both the incident and the absence of any backup generator for the sirens.

topics.headline: BLM approves first commercial AI data center on public land
topics.snippet: On June 26, 2026 the Bureau of Land Management approved the Townsite Data Center on 88.5 acres of federal land in Eldorado Valley, Nevada, within Boulder City, land originally designated for a solar f…
topics.text:
blm approves first commercial ai data center on public land
on june 26, 2026 the bureau of land management approved the townsite data center on 88.5 acres of federal land in eldorado valley, nevada, within boulder city, land originally designated for a solar farm. the facility would draw up to 167 megawatts, more than boulder city itself consumes, and add two warehouse-scale buildings, a substation, battery storage, backup generators and a new road in desert tortoise habitat. blm's las vegas field office manager approved it without a new environmental assessment or public comment, calling it substantially the same as the solar proposal. boulder city and two environmental organisations have filed appeals.

topics.headline: BLM moves to revoke the Chaco Canyon protective buffer
topics.snippet: The Bureau of Land Management's preferred alternative would reopen 336,000 acres around Chaco Canyon to drilling, mining and uranium claims, revoking the 10-mile buffer established in 2023. The area c…
topics.text:
blm moves to revoke the chaco canyon protective buffer
the bureau of land management's preferred alternative would reopen 336,000 acres around chaco canyon to drilling, mining and uranium claims, revoking the 10-mile buffer established in 2023. the area contains more than 7,500 known historic sites and some of the darkest night skies in the country, and pueblo and diné families live on and use the landscape. blm's own assessment finds under 1 percent of the land has development potential. the public comment period ran only 14 days and closed at midnight on july 29.

topics.snippet: The United States announced a new Iran-related sanctions action targeting eight tankers and ten entities. Six of the sanctioned entities are based in China.
topics.text:
us sanctions eight tankers and ten entities over iran
the united states announced a new iran-related sanctions action targeting eight tankers and ten entities. six of the sanctioned entities are based in china.

topics.snippet: The United Nations warned that settler violence in the West Bank is getting worse. U.N. figures cited by Reuters record 18 people killed in incidents linked to settler attacks so far in 2026, compared…
topics.text:
un warns of worsening settler violence in the west bank
the united nations warned that settler violence in the west bank is getting worse. u.n. figures cited by reuters record 18 people killed in incidents linked to settler attacks so far in 2026, compared with 17 in all of 2025.

topics.headline: Democratic support for Israel erodes sharply
topics.snippet: A Quinnipiac University poll from June 2026 found 66 percent of Democrats say the United States is too supportive of Israel, up from 20 percent in 2017. Israel is becoming a growing dividing line with…
topics.text:
democratic support for israel erodes sharply
a quinnipiac university poll from june 2026 found 66 percent of democrats say the united states is too supportive of israel, up from 20 percent in 2017. israel is becoming a growing dividing line within the democratic party.

topics.headline: Reuters finds 31% dismissal rate in Trump DOJ officer-assault cases
topics.snippet: A Reuters review of federal court records found that 31 percent of completed federal officer-assault cases brought under the Trump administration ended in dismissal, against a typical federal rate of…
topics.text:
reuters finds 31% dismissal rate in trump doj officer-assault cases
a reuters review of federal court records found that 31 percent of completed federal officer-assault cases brought under the trump administration ended in dismissal, against a typical federal rate of 8 percent. defendants often bore lasting costs before the cases were dropped.

topics.headline: Army awards Lockheed Martin Patriot contract worth up to $58.6 billion
topics.snippet: The US Army awarded Lockheed Martin a seven-year integrated air and missile defence agreement running through 2032, valued at up to $58.6 billion. The contract covers PAC-3 MSE missiles and the MHTK i…
topics.text:
army awards lockheed martin patriot contract worth up to $58.6 billion
the us army awarded lockheed martin a seven-year integrated air and missile defence agreement running through 2032, valued at up to $58.6 billion. the contract covers pac-3 mse missiles and the mhtk interceptor.

topics.headline: SpaceX wins $1.6 billion Space Force launch order
topics.snippet: SpaceX was awarded $1.6 billion for 18 Space Force launches on Falcon 9, scheduled through 2027. The missions will carry Space Force satellites for detecting and targeting airborne objects.
topics.text:
spacex wins $1.6 billion space force launch order
spacex was awarded $1.6 billion for 18 space force launches on falcon 9, scheduled through 2027. the missions will carry space force satellites for detecting and targeting airborne objects.

topics.snippet: Oil prices slipped as talks over the Strait of Hormuz ran into renewed US-Iran tensions. Markets moved against the backdrop of the latest strikes.
topics.text:
oil swings as hormuz talks collide with us strikes
oil prices slipped as talks over the strait of hormuz ran into renewed us-iran tensions. markets moved against the backdrop of the latest strikes.

topics.snippet: Chicago wheat edged higher as disruptions to Black Sea exports raised supply concerns. Russian grain terminals have restricted deliveries amid shipping risks.
topics.text:
wheat prices rise on black sea export disruptions
chicago wheat edged higher as disruptions to black sea exports raised supply concerns. russian grain terminals have restricted deliveries amid shipping risks.

topics.headline: Nine schools in three states to deploy pepper-spraying anti-shooter drones
topics.snippet: Nine schools across Colorado, Florida and Georgia are installing drones designed to confront active shooters, according to footage of a live reenactment obtained by the Washington Post. The drones can…
topics.text:
nine schools in three states to deploy pepper-spraying anti-shooter drones
nine schools across colorado, florida and georgia are installing drones designed to confront active shooters, according to footage of a live reenactment obtained by the washington post. the drones can smash through windows, deploy pepper spray and reach a shooter within 15 seconds. critics say the deployment reflects legislative inaction on gun violence and question whether the approach prevents shootings.

topics.headline: Booker criticised for invoking Christianity in Senate immigration debate
topics.snippet: During a Senate floor debate on immigration, Sen. Cory Booker asked colleagues whether removals reflect the values of their faiths, noting most members of the body are Christians and asking whether Je…
topics.text:
booker criticised for invoking christianity in senate immigration debate
during a senate floor debate on immigration, sen. cory booker asked colleagues whether removals reflect the values of their faiths, noting most members of the body are christians and asking whether jesus would send someone into danger. critics said invoking christianity in a legislative argument mirrors tactics used by the right and conflicts with the separation of church and state. they argued the case should instead rest on habeas corpus and the legal right to seek asylum.

topics.headline: UEFA votes to boycott World Cup over Kushner-linked privatisation plan
topics.snippet: All 55 UEFA member associations agreed at an emergency meeting to boycott the World Cup if FIFA proceeds with plans to sell ownership stakes to private investment groups backed by the Kushner family.…
topics.text:
uefa votes to boycott world cup over kushner-linked privatisation plan
all 55 uefa member associations agreed at an emergency meeting to boycott the world cup if fifa proceeds with plans to sell ownership stakes to private investment groups backed by the kushner family. concacaf has since rejected fifa president gianni infantino's proposal, and us soccer issued its own statement standing with concacaf. the atlantic reports a large majority of concacaf members are losing confidence in infantino, and democrats say they will open wide-ranging investigations into fifa and infantino if they take the house in november.

topics.headline: State Department mislabels every African country on map at global AIDS conference
topics.snippet: The US State Department presented a map of Africa at a global AIDS conference in Brazil that mislabelled every country on the continent, according to Reuters Africa. Nigeria was placed landlocked in t…
topics.text:
state department mislabels every african country on map at global aids conference
the us state department presented a map of africa at a global aids conference in brazil that mislabelled every country on the continent, according to reuters africa. nigeria was placed landlocked in the sahara, mozambique was relocated to the horn of africa and the ivory coast was moved across the continent, along with errors for uganda, malawi and cameroon. the map circulated widely online.

topics.headline: White House account posts nicotine-pouch promotion featuring US troops
topics.snippet: The official White House account published a post using footage of American troops to promote Zyn nicotine pouches. The clip cites consumption figures including more than 6 million meals, an estimated…
topics.text:
white house account posts nicotine-pouch promotion featuring us troops
the official white house account published a post using footage of american troops to promote zyn nicotine pouches. the clip cites consumption figures including more than 6 million meals, an estimated 950,000 gallons of coffee, 2 million energy drinks and nicotine.

topics.headline: Iran strikes U.S. bases as FOIA data points to more than 400 American deaths
topics.snippet: Data obtained through a Freedom of Information Act request to the Defense Manpower Data Center indicates that more than 400 U.S. service members have died in the Iran-U.S. war, a figure above what has…
topics.text:
iran strikes u.s. bases as foia data points to more than 400 american deaths
data obtained through a freedom of information act request to the defense manpower data center indicates that more than 400 u.s. service members have died in the iran-u.s. war, a figure above what has been publicly reported. an iranian ballistic missile struck a u.s. base in jordan overnight, drawing that country further into the conflict, and a separate surprise attack was launched on american bases in the middle east. china is reported to be supplying iran with roughly 400 air defense missile launchers valued at $60 million to $70 million. president trump responded with profane remarks and said the united states would strike iran extremely hard, despite earlier statements that both sides wanted to negotiate.

topics.headline: Thune says Senate lacks votes for SAVE Act as Trump misses birthright citizenship deadline
topics.snippet: Senate Majority Leader John Thune confirmed that Republicans do not have the votes to pass the SAVE Act or to eliminate the filibuster, leaving the bill with no path before the November elections. Rep…
topics.text:
thune says senate lacks votes for save act as trump misses birthright citizenship deadline
senate majority leader john thune confirmed that republicans do not have the votes to pass the save act or to eliminate the filibuster, leaving the bill with no path before the november elections. republicans may attempt to move it through budget reconciliation, but the votes are not currently there for that route either. separately, trump's legal team missed the deadline to ask the supreme court for a rehearing in his birthright citizenship case, foreclosing that appeal.

topics.headline: Epstein survivors hand files to senators ahead of Todd Blanche confirmation vote
topics.snippet: More than ten Epstein survivors went office to office on Capitol Hill delivering copies of the Epstein files to Republican and Democratic senators, focusing on members of the Judiciary Committee. Offi…
topics.text:
epstein survivors hand files to senators ahead of todd blanche confirmation vote
more than ten epstein survivors went office to office on capitol hill delivering copies of the epstein files to republican and democratic senators, focusing on members of the judiciary committee. offices visited included those of senators katie britt, mike lee, josh hawley and john kennedy. the effort is aimed at persuading senators to vote against the confirmation of todd blanche, scheduled for the following day, and organizers said they would continue pressing the issue regardless of the outcome.

topics.headline: Trump administration to end Medicare Part D subsidies at the close of 2026
topics.snippet: The administration announced overnight that Medicare Part D subsidies will expire at the end of 2026 and will not be available heading into 2027. The program works with private insurers to lower the c…
topics.text:
trump administration to end medicare part d subsidies at the close of 2026
the administration announced overnight that medicare part d subsidies will expire at the end of 2026 and will not be available heading into 2027. the program works with private insurers to lower the cost of brand-name and generic prescriptions for medicare enrollees, most of whom are seniors or people with disabilities. dr. mehmet oz, who heads the centers for medicare and medicaid services, said the subsidies would be cut off at year's end. millions of enrollees are expected to face higher prescription costs as a result.

topics.headline: Fauci invokes Fifth Amendment throughout congressional hearing
topics.snippet: Anthony Fauci declined to answer questions at a congressional hearing, invoking his Fifth Amendment rights in response to every question put to him, including from Senator Rand Paul. Among the unanswe…
topics.text:
fauci invokes fifth amendment throughout congressional hearing
anthony fauci declined to answer questions at a congressional hearing, invoking his fifth amendment rights in response to every question put to him, including from senator rand paul. among the unanswered questions were whether he was made aware of gain-of-function research on monkeypox at the national biodefense analysis and countermeasures center at fort detrick, and whether the cia transferred funds to the nih under an interagency agreement. one of fauci's attorneys was removed from the room by security after the chair repeatedly told him he was not recognized and had been instructed not to sit at the witness table. questioning also covered fauci's past remarks about making daily life difficult for people who declined covid-19 vaccination.

topics.headline: CENTCOM warns troops that shared videos help Iran assess strikes
topics.snippet: The top U.S. commander for the Middle East warned service members that videos they post can help Iran evaluate the effects of its strikes on American bases. Sources said restrictions on phone use, inc…
topics.text:
centcom warns troops that shared videos help iran assess strikes
the top u.s. commander for the middle east warned service members that videos they post can help iran evaluate the effects of its strikes on american bases. sources said restrictions on phone use, including confiscation of personal devices, are under consideration.

topics.headline: Iraq's Iran-backed armed factions number about 50,000 fighters
topics.snippet: Iraq's network of Iran-aligned armed groups comprises roughly 50,000 fighters spread across about ten hardline factions, according to two security officials cited by Reuters. The groups form a signifi…
topics.text:
iraq's iran-backed armed factions number about 50,000 fighters
iraq's network of iran-aligned armed groups comprises roughly 50,000 fighters spread across about ten hardline factions, according to two security officials cited by reuters. the groups form a significant element of the regional security picture as the conflict involving iran continues.

topics.headline: Russia charges Telegram founder Pavel Durov with aiding terrorism
topics.snippet: Russian authorities have charged Telegram founder Pavel Durov over the platform's alleged use by Ukrainian intelligence services. The FSB said Durov has been placed on an international wanted list.
topics.text:
russia charges telegram founder pavel durov with aiding terrorism
russian authorities have charged telegram founder pavel durov over the platform's alleged use by ukrainian intelligence services. the fsb said durov has been placed on an international wanted list.

topics.headline: Defense Department post shows AI prompt asking to build an agent to generate a war
topics.snippet: An official post from the Department of War's account, attributed to the Undersecretary for Research and Engineering, described new AI task forces embedded within the U.S. Pacific Fleet. An image incl…
topics.text:
defense department post shows ai prompt asking to build an agent to generate a war
an official post from the department of war's account, attributed to the undersecretary for research and engineering, described new ai task forces embedded within the u.s. pacific fleet. an image included in the post shows a service member typing a prompt to an ai assistant reading, "i need help building an agent to generate a war." the detail circulated widely online, raising questions about whether it was deliberate or an operational security lapse.

topics.headline: Iran launches ballistic missiles at U.S. forces in the Middle East
topics.snippet: U.S. Central Command said Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps forces launched multiple ballistic missiles from Iran at 5:45 p.m. ET on July 28 in what it described as an attempted surprise attack on U.S…
topics.text:
iran launches ballistic missiles at u.s. forces in the middle east
u.s. central command said islamic revolutionary guard corps forces launched multiple ballistic missiles from iran at 5:45 p.m. et on july 28 in what it described as an attempted surprise attack on u.s. bases in the middle east. centcom said all of the missiles were successfully intercepted. it added that u.s. forces remain vigilant and at a high state of readiness.

topics.headline: Trump hosts Netanyahu and Zelensky as both attend Graham funeral
topics.snippet: Donald Trump met separately with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky at the White House on July 28, with both leaders also attending Senator Lindsey Gr…
topics.text:
trump hosts netanyahu and zelensky as both attend graham funeral
donald trump met separately with israeli prime minister benjamin netanyahu and ukrainian president volodymyr zelensky at the white house on july 28, with both leaders also attending senator lindsey graham's funeral the same day. the white house said the sessions were one-on-one meetings rather than a three-way summit, and the visits came as the iran and ukraine wars reached critical stages. netanyahu, who is subject to an international criminal court arrest warrant, has visited the united states more often than any other foreign leader over the past two years. graham had recently returned from ukraine and was among the republican party's strongest backers of ukrainian and israeli policy; a photograph of netanyahu with marco rubio and pete hegseth at the funeral circulated widely, as did sean hannity's eulogy remarks praising graham's support for israel.

topics.headline: Gulf states back Omani plan for voluntary Iranian fees in Strait of Hormuz
topics.snippet: Gulf states have endorsed an Omani proposal under which Iran would collect voluntary fees for passage through the Strait of Hormuz, according to a source cited by Reuters. Roughly one in five barrels…
topics.text:
gulf states back omani plan for voluntary iranian fees in strait of hormuz
gulf states have endorsed an omani proposal under which iran would collect voluntary fees for passage through the strait of hormuz, according to a source cited by reuters. roughly one in five barrels of the world's oil consumption normally transits the strait. the plan comes amid continuing tension between iran and the united states over the waterway.

topics.headline: Expanding yellow line in Gaza displaces families again
topics.snippet: Residents of Gaza say the advancing yellow line demarcating Israeli-controlled territory is forcing families to relocate once more. Those affected describe repeated displacement as the boundary shifts…
topics.text:
expanding yellow line in gaza displaces families again
residents of gaza say the advancing yellow line demarcating israeli-controlled territory is forcing families to relocate once more. those affected describe repeated displacement as the boundary shifts. the expansion is the latest change to movement and territory inside the territory.

topics.headline: ICE escalates arrests of travellers with expired visas at U.S. airports
topics.snippet: Immigration and Customs Enforcement is stepping up stops and arrests at airports, prioritising people with expired visas who are travelling within the United States, according to the New York Times. T…
topics.text:
ice escalates arrests of travellers with expired visas at u.s. airports
immigration and customs enforcement is stepping up stops and arrests at airports, prioritising people with expired visas who are travelling within the united states, according to the new york times. the reporting describes cooperation between tsa and ice that had not previously existed and at least a dozen instances of such detentions. many of those affected are awaiting green cards or visa extensions, a group that had rarely been detained at airports before.

topics.headline: More than 12,000 arrested after child migrant agency shared data with ICE
topics.snippet: Reuters found that more than 12,000 people were arrested after the U.S. agency responsible for unaccompanied migrant children passed leads to Immigration and Customs Enforcement. The data came from re…
topics.text:
more than 12,000 arrested after child migrant agency shared data with ice
reuters found that more than 12,000 people were arrested after the u.s. agency responsible for unaccompanied migrant children passed leads to immigration and customs enforcement. the data came from records tied to the sponsorship and placement of child migrants. the arrests followed the transfer of that information to enforcement officers.

topics.headline: ICE used forced medical treatment on hunger-striking detainee
topics.snippet: A document released by ICE and reviewed by the Guardian shows that for the first time the administration applied forced medical treatment to a detainee on hunger strike in immigration detention. The u…
topics.text:
ice used forced medical treatment on hunger-striking detainee
a document released by ice and reviewed by the guardian shows that for the first time the administration applied forced medical treatment to a detainee on hunger strike in immigration detention. the unnamed patient, who began the hunger strike between october and december of last year, was subject to forced feeding, hydration, forced urinary catheterisation or involuntary blood draws. international human rights groups have described such treatment during hunger strikes as tantamount to torture, and it can carry significant medical complications.

topics.headline: Texas police searched 83,000 Flock cameras to trace woman suspected of self-managed abortion
topics.snippet: According to 404 Media, Texas authorities searched 83,000 Flock automated licence plate cameras nationwide in April 2025 while looking for a woman a sheriff said had self-administered an abortion, cit…
topics.text:
texas police searched 83,000 flock cameras to trace woman suspected of self-managed abortion
according to 404 media, texas authorities searched 83,000 flock automated licence plate cameras nationwide in april 2025 while looking for a woman a sheriff said had self-administered an abortion, citing family concern for her safety. the searches extended beyond states where abortion is illegal to states where it remains legal, including washington and illinois. no charges resulted, but experts warn the case shows police in restrictive states can query camera networks in states where abortion is protected.

topics.headline: First data center approved on federal public land after review was skipped
topics.snippet: The Bureau of Land Management approved a data center in Boulder City, Nevada, on public land by treating it as substantially the same as the solar and battery storage project a developer had permitted…
topics.text:
first data center approved on federal public land after review was skipped
the bureau of land management approved a data center in boulder city, nevada, on public land by treating it as substantially the same as the solar and battery storage project a developer had permitted there in 2023. no new environmental review was conducted and there was no public comment period, and the city learned of the decision afterwards. it is the first data center approved on blm-managed land, and the pentagon is separately leasing military land to private data center developers in texas and utah, where a military land designation removed a box elder county project from county control. a bill to ban data centers on federal land has been introduced, and a petition asks the interior department to rescind the approval.

topics.headline: Inver Grove Heights council meeting breaks down over data center variance
topics.snippet: A city council meeting in Inver Grove Heights descended into shouting ahead of a discussion of data centers, with residents objecting that no community input or public comment was required before the…
topics.text:
inver grove heights council meeting breaks down over data center variance
a city council meeting in inver grove heights descended into shouting ahead of a discussion of data centers, with residents objecting that no community input or public comment was required before the council approved a variance. the mayor left the meeting without answering questions. attendees said it was at least the second or third time the process had unfolded that way.

topics.headline: Great Salt Lake nears total loss as toxic dust spreads across northern Utah
topics.snippet: The Great Salt Lake is close to dried up and toxic dust is blowing across northern Utah, even as residents cut water use and utilities charge premiums for heavy consumption. Some 62% of the water that…
topics.text:
great salt lake nears total loss as toxic dust spreads across northern utah
the great salt lake is close to dried up and toxic dust is blowing across northern utah, even as residents cut water use and utilities charge premiums for heavy consumption. some 62% of the water that would otherwise reach the lake is diverted for human use, 71% of that goes to agriculture, and 81% of the agricultural share grows hay and alfalfa, crops that account for less than 1% of utah's gdp; estimates suggest a third to a half of that output is shipped overseas, mainly to china. governor spencer cox, an alfalfa farm owner, has appointed farmer hannah freese as great salt lake commissioner to coordinate rescue, conservation and policy plans; two years ago she was selling "make alfalfa great again" hats on facebook.

topics.headline: Beshear tells McConnell to explain his absence or resign
topics.snippet: Kentucky Governor Andy Beshear sent a follow-up letter to Senator Mitch McConnell demanding an explanation of his health issues and continued absence from the Senate, or his resignation. The letter, o…
topics.text:
beshear tells mcconnell to explain his absence or resign
kentucky governor andy beshear sent a follow-up letter to senator mitch mcconnell demanding an explanation of his health issues and continued absence from the senate, or his resignation. the letter, obtained by cnn, states that beshear is writing on the assumption mcconnell is capable of reading and responding and is not incapacitated in consciousness or cognition; the daily beast reported it was also sent to senate republican leader john thune. beshear has no power as governor to force a resignation, but is pressing senate republicans to investigate.

topics.headline: Trump's age and health draw fresh scrutiny after Graham's death
topics.snippet: The Washington Post reports that Trump has been talking privately about his own mortality following Lindsey Graham's sudden death, raising whether Graham's travel schedule contributed to his declining…
topics.text:
trump's age and health draw fresh scrutiny after graham's death
the washington post reports that trump has been talking privately about his own mortality following lindsey graham's sudden death, raising whether graham's travel schedule contributed to his declining health and examining graham's family history for genetic factors. at 80, trump is the oldest president in american history and has two years left in his term. at graham's funeral he appeared to struggle to stay awake, with observers describing periods of several minutes when he seemed asleep, along with visible discomfort during the eulogies.

topics.headline: U.S. drone production trails far behind Ukraine's output
topics.snippet: Ukraine is on track to produce roughly 500,000 drones a month, while cumulative Pentagon program orders stood below 200,000 as of February. The Pentagon is pushing to build a domestic drone supply cha…
topics.text:
u.s. drone production trails far behind ukraine's output
ukraine is on track to produce roughly 500,000 drones a month, while cumulative pentagon program orders stood below 200,000 as of february. the pentagon is pushing to build a domestic drone supply chain to close the gap. the comparison covers projected ukrainian output against total u.s. program orders to date.

topics.text:
kremlin monitors wildberries after ukrainian drone strikes on warehouses
russia is monitoring the retailer wildberries following ukrainian drone attacks that hit eight warehouses. more than 10% of the company's storage capacity has been affected since july 18. no decision on state aid has been made.

topics.headline: Former Navy SEAL sentenced for plot to bomb No Kings protest
topics.snippet: Gregory Vandenberg, 49, a former Navy SEAL, has been convicted and sentenced to 16 months in federal prison for plotting to attack a No Kings protest in San Diego with explosives. The sentence was han…
topics.text:
former navy seal sentenced for plot to bomb no kings protest
gregory vandenberg, 49, a former navy seal, has been convicted and sentenced to 16 months in federal prison for plotting to attack a no kings protest in san diego with explosives. the sentence was handed down in federal court.

topics.snippet: Representative Thomas Massie said on X that the Israeli lobby spent $30 million to defeat him but that "America won" because a generation is now aware of its influence on the U.S. government. He claim…
topics.text:
massie says israeli lobby spent $30 million against his campaign
representative thomas massie said on x that the israeli lobby spent $30 million to defeat him but that "america won" because a generation is now aware of its influence on the u.s. government. he claimed every elected republican in congress is bought, captured or intimidated by that lobby to some degree, and described himself as the last who is not.

topics.headline: Trump administration moves to block new Chinese robots and inverters
topics.snippet: Officials say the Trump administration plans import bans on newly introduced Chinese robot and inverter models. The measures are framed as a technology security step. They would extend existing restri…
topics.text:
trump administration moves to block new chinese robots and inverters
officials say the trump administration plans import bans on newly introduced chinese robot and inverter models. the measures are framed as a technology security step. they would extend existing restrictions to additional product categories.

topics.headline: AI firms buying and shredding rare books to train models
topics.snippet: Reporting from Futurism and 404 Media says AI companies are bulk-buying antique and rare books, scanning them on high-speed machines that cut off the spines, and shredding the originals. A federal jud…
topics.text:
ai firms buying and shredding rare books to train models
reporting from futurism and 404 media says ai companies are bulk-buying antique and rare books, scanning them on high-speed machines that cut off the spines, and shredding the originals. a federal judge has ruled the practice is fair use on the grounds that destroying the original keeps only one copy in existence at a time. nobody in the pipeline checks whether a given volume is the last surviving copy, and local histories and self-published war memoirs are among the material being destroyed.

topics.headline: Canadian tourism boycott costs U.S. more than $3 billion
topics.snippet: A new report from the Canadian government shows the United States has lost more than $3 billion in revenue as Canadians avoid travelling there. Visits in July fell 30% year over year, the sharpest suc…
topics.text:
canadian tourism boycott costs u.s. more than $3 billion
a new report from the canadian government shows the united states has lost more than $3 billion in revenue as canadians avoid travelling there. visits in july fell 30% year over year, the sharpest such decline since 2001. cited causes include tariffs on canada and the administration's remarks about canadians and wildfire smoke.

topics.headline: FIFA plan would hand World Cup operations to Kushner-backed company
topics.snippet: FIFA president Gianni Infantino announced a plan to create a $20 billion private company, backed by the Kushner family alongside other private investors, to run the World Cup. The proposal was first r…
topics.text:
fifa plan would hand world cup operations to kushner-backed company
fifa president gianni infantino announced a plan to create a $20 billion private company, backed by the kushner family alongside other private investors, to run the world cup. the proposal was first reported by the financial times. uefa responded that football "is not fifa's to sell" and that none of the governing bodies own the sport; trump has also said he wants infantino appointed un secretary general.

topics.headline: Bipartisan House bill would direct State Department to disrupt North Korean activity
topics.snippet: House Resolution 9963, introduced on July 27, would authorise the Secretary of State to coordinate with allies and partners to detect, attribute and disrupt certain North Korean activities. It is spon…
topics.text:
bipartisan house bill would direct state department to disrupt north korean activity
house resolution 9963, introduced on july 27, would authorise the secretary of state to coordinate with allies and partners to detect, attribute and disrupt certain north korean activities. it is sponsored by representative kim young of california's 40th district, a republican, with democrat ami bera of california's 6th district as co-sponsor. the measure has been referred to the foreign affairs committee and must clear hearings and markup before any vote; the current congress passes only about 1% to 3% of introduced bills.

topics.headline: Berlin Pride attack suspect recorded pledge to Islamic State, prosecutors say
topics.snippet: German prosecutors say the suspect in the attack at Berlin Pride recorded a pledge of allegiance to Islamic State. The recording is part of the case being assembled against him. Officials described th…
topics.text:
berlin pride attack suspect recorded pledge to islamic state, prosecutors say
german prosecutors say the suspect in the attack at berlin pride recorded a pledge of allegiance to islamic state. the recording is part of the case being assembled against him. officials described the tie as central to the investigation.

topics.headline: Federal survey finds daily marijuana use now exceeds alcohol and cigarettes
topics.snippet: The National Survey on Drug Use and Health, released this week, found about 21.4 million Americans aged 12 and over report using marijuana daily or near-daily, defined as more than 20 times in a 30-da…
topics.text:
federal survey finds daily marijuana use now exceeds alcohol and cigarettes
the national survey on drug use and health, released this week, found about 21.4 million americans aged 12 and over report using marijuana daily or near-daily, defined as more than 20 times in a 30-day period. that compares with 17.2 million reporting near-daily alcohol use and 19.9 million reporting near-daily cigarette use. it is the first time marijuana has topped both in the survey.

topics.headline: Tusk urges end to xenophobic attacks on Ukrainians in Poland
topics.snippet: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk called for an end to xenophobic attacks against Ukrainians following recent incidents. His appeal comes amid rising hate-crime reports in the country. Tusk addressed…
topics.text:
tusk urges end to xenophobic attacks on ukrainians in poland
polish prime minister donald tusk called for an end to xenophobic attacks against ukrainians following recent incidents. his appeal comes amid rising hate-crime reports in the country. tusk addressed the issue directly to the polish public.

topics.headline: Netanyahu and Zelensky both head to Washington as wars converge
topics.snippet: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky are both travelling to Washington for separate one-on-one meetings with President Donald Trump, according to White…
topics.text:
netanyahu and zelensky both head to washington as wars converge
israeli prime minister benjamin netanyahu and ukrainian president volodymyr zelensky are both travelling to washington for separate one-on-one meetings with president donald trump, according to white house accounts, and both are also expected to attend the funeral of senator lindsey graham. netanyahu remains subject to an international criminal court warrant, but the united states never ratified the rome statute after bill clinton signed it without congressional approval and george w. bush withdrew the signature in 2002, so he cannot be arrested on us soil. graham, a longtime backer of both ukraine and israel, had recently returned from a trip to ukraine before his death. multiple heads of state attending a us senator's funeral is described as highly unusual.

topics.headline: Iran halts attacks while US bombing pause holds as drone strikes test the truce
topics.snippet: A senior Iranian official told Reuters that Iran will halt its attacks for as long as the US bombing pause remains in place, after both sides held fire for two days. Tehran remains sceptical that the…
topics.text:
iran halts attacks while us bombing pause holds as drone strikes test the truce
a senior iranian official told reuters that iran will halt its attacks for as long as the us bombing pause remains in place, after both sides held fire for two days. tehran remains sceptical that the pause will last. drone attacks reported across saudi arabia, jordan and iraq are testing the pause, with the source of some of the drones still unclear.

topics.headline: Iran blames Ukraine for strike on commercial vessel, raising fears of merging wars
topics.snippet: Iran's foreign minister accused President Volodymyr Zelensky and Ukraine of attacking an Iranian commercial vessel and killing an Iranian sailor. The minister said the strike was carried out on Israel…
topics.text:
iran blames ukraine for strike on commercial vessel, raising fears of merging wars
iran's foreign minister accused president volodymyr zelensky and ukraine of attacking an iranian commercial vessel and killing an iranian sailor. the minister said the strike was carried out on israel's behalf in an effort to draw europe into a broader war. ukraine has confirmed the strikes on iranian vessels were deliberate, raising concern that the russia-ukraine conflict and the us-israel confrontation with iran are converging into a single wider war involving yemen and gulf states.

topics.headline: Trump calls heckler a communist after being accused of protecting a pedophile
topics.snippet: At a rally, a heckler repeatedly shouted that President Donald Trump was a pedophile protector while Trump was describing tariffs on foreign manufacturers, including a 25 percent tariff on foreign aut…
topics.text:
trump calls heckler a communist after being accused of protecting a pedophile
at a rally, a heckler repeatedly shouted that president donald trump was a pedophile protector while trump was describing tariffs on foreign manufacturers, including a 25 percent tariff on foreign automobiles. trump did not address the accusation and instead called the man a communist. the exchange has been tied to continued pressure over the administration's failure to release the epstein files.

topics.headline: Federal judge orders Trump trust to open financial records to the BBC
topics.snippet: A federal magistrate judge in South Florida entered an order requiring Donald Trump's revocable trust, which manages his properties and companies during his presidency, to turn over financial records…
topics.text:
federal judge orders trump trust to open financial records to the bbc
a federal magistrate judge in south florida entered an order requiring donald trump's revocable trust, which manages his properties and companies during his presidency, to turn over financial records to the bbc. the order stems from trump's $10 billion defamation suit against the broadcaster, in which he alleged significant financial harm. that claim opened the door for the bbc to seek the underlying financials to test whether the alleged harm occurred. an appeal is considered likely.

topics.headline: Court filings accuse Rep. Max Miller of assaulting his wife and injuring his daughter
topics.snippet: New court filings obtained by Mother Jones allege that Representative Max Miller, a Republican from Ohio, poured hot water on his wife, shoved her and held a gun to her head. His wife, policy adviser…
topics.text:
court filings accuse rep. max miller of assaulting his wife and injuring his daughter
new court filings obtained by mother jones allege that representative max miller, a republican from ohio, poured hot water on his wife, shoved her and held a gun to her head. his wife, policy adviser emily moreno, daughter of ohio senator bernie moreno, told detectives she could not rule out that miller caused a fracture to their two-year-old daughter's collarbone. child protection specialists reviewing the case described bruising near the fracture as resembling a handprint.

topics.snippet: Kentucky Governor Andy Beshear sent a follow-up letter to Senator Mitch McConnell demanding an explanation of his health issues or his resignation, writing that he was addressing the letter under the…
topics.text:
beshear tells mcconnell to explain his absence or resign as new image is released
kentucky governor andy beshear sent a follow-up letter to senator mitch mcconnell demanding an explanation of his health issues or his resignation, writing that he was addressing the letter under the assumption mcconnell is capable of reading and responding and is not incapacitated. the letter was also sent to senate republican leader john thune. mcconnell's office released a second image of the senator with his wife elaine chao, this one without a newspaper, alongside a statement from his physician saying he continues to recover from a june fall at home and has not been medically cleared to leave a rehabilitation facility. he will not attend fancy farm in kentucky this weekend. beshear has no power to force a resignation.

topics.headline: Bureau of Land Management approves first data center on public land
topics.snippet: The Bureau of Land Management approved converting a 2023 solar and battery storage permit in Boulder City, Nevada into a data center, on the reasoning that the two uses are substantially the same. The…
topics.text:
bureau of land management approves first data center on public land
the bureau of land management approved converting a 2023 solar and battery storage permit in boulder city, nevada into a data center, on the reasoning that the two uses are substantially the same. the switch was approved with no new environmental review and no public comment period, and the city learned of it afterward. it is the first data center ever approved on blm-managed public land. similar routes are being used elsewhere, including a military land designation in box elder county, utah and pentagon leases of military land to private data center developers in texas and utah. a bill to ban data centers on federal land has been introduced.

topics.headline: Data centers linked to power flickers across the eastern United States
topics.snippet: Electricity flickered on and off for roughly 10 minutes across the eastern United States, from Chicago to Boston to Miami, on July 22. Experts speaking to NBC4 Washington linked the event to demand fr…
topics.text:
data centers linked to power flickers across the eastern united states
electricity flickered on and off for roughly 10 minutes across the eastern united states, from chicago to boston to miami, on july 22. experts speaking to nbc4 washington linked the event to demand from data centers in loudoun county, virginia, including the concentration in ashburn known as data center alley. the disruption was visible to millions of homes and businesses, and experts warn that further data center construction will increase strain on the grid.

topics.headline: Three killed at Seattle food festival as US logs 271st mass shooting of 2026
topics.snippet: Three people were killed and several others wounded, including a toddler, in a shooting at the Bite of Seattle food festival. One suspect is in custody. It was one of six mass shootings in the United…
topics.text:
three killed at seattle food festival as us logs 271st mass shooting of 2026
three people were killed and several others wounded, including a toddler, in a shooting at the bite of seattle food festival. one suspect is in custody. it was one of six mass shootings in the united states over 48 hours, with others in memphis, north charleston, coyote creek and san francisco, bringing the 2026 total to 271.

twelve killed including children in drone attack on zaporizhzhia holiday camp
a drone attack on a holiday camp in zaporizhzhia killed 12 people, including children. russian-installed officials have accused ukraine of carrying out the strike. kyiv has not yet responded.

republican strategists urge candidates to distance themselves from trump
a report from msnow says senior republicans are advising incumbents and challengers to distance themselves from president donald trump on the campaign trail ahead of november. strategists reportedly warn that running on the trump agenda will cost them their races, citing his declining popularity, particularly over the war in iran.

oil prices declined as markets responded to the fragile pause in strikes between the united states and iran. new attacks in the region kept risk levels elevated.

topics.snippet: Bill Oliver, a legislator in New Brunswick, Canada, read aloud the artificial intelligence prompt and its instructions while delivering a speech on the legislative floor about advocacy offices. Video…
topics.text:
new brunswick legislator reads ai prompt aloud during floor speech
bill oliver, a legislator in new brunswick, canada, read aloud the artificial intelligence prompt and its instructions while delivering a speech on the legislative floor about advocacy offices. video of the moment circulated widely. the incident adds to a growing set of cases of elected officials using ai-generated text for official remarks.

topics.headline: US halts plans to escalate Iran war as munitions stockpiles run low
topics.snippet: Senior military leaders, including Joint Chiefs chairman General Cain, and Vice President JD Vance privately warned President Trump that continuing the air campaign against Iran risks depleting Americ…
topics.text:
us halts plans to escalate iran war as munitions stockpiles run low
senior military leaders, including joint chiefs chairman general cain, and vice president jd vance privately warned president trump that continuing the air campaign against iran risks depleting american munitions and patriot interceptor inventories needed to defend us forces across the region. after 13 straight days of bombing, strikes stopped friday and saturday night, and trump has ruled out a wider escalation for now. air defenses in the middle east are reportedly allowing some incoming missiles through when they are not aimed at us troops, in order to conserve interceptors. the pentagon has requested more than a trillion dollars in further funding, already approved by the house.

topics.headline: Iranian drone strikes US air base in Iraq
topics.snippet: An Iranian drone was fired at a United States Air Force base in Iraq and made contact, according to footage circulated within an hour of the strike. Casualty figures are not yet known. A US response i…
topics.text:
iranian drone strikes us air base in iraq
an iranian drone was fired at a united states air force base in iraq and made contact, according to footage circulated within an hour of the strike. casualty figures are not yet known. a us response is anticipated.

topics.headline: Trump escalates effort to dismantle the International Criminal Court
topics.snippet: President Trump and Secretary of State Marco Rubio are intensifying efforts to dismantle the International Criminal Court, most recently by supporting Venezuela's withdrawal from it. The court has out…
topics.text:
trump escalates effort to dismantle the international criminal court
president trump and secretary of state marco rubio are intensifying efforts to dismantle the international criminal court, most recently by supporting venezuela's withdrawal from it. the court has outstanding arrest warrants for figures including benjamin netanyahu on war crimes allegations. the court does not have jurisdiction over an american president, but a warrant could restrict travel to member states and could theoretically be acted on domestically by a future administration that joined the court.

topics.headline: US among ten countries voting against extending UN human rights chief's mandate
topics.snippet: A United Nations vote extended the mandate of the UN human rights chief by 144 votes in favour, with 10 against and 13 absent. The United States voted against, alongside Russia, North Korea, Nicaragua…
topics.text:
us among ten countries voting against extending un human rights chief's mandate
a united nations vote extended the mandate of the un human rights chief by 144 votes in favour, with 10 against and 13 absent. the united states voted against, alongside russia, north korea, nicaragua, mali, israel, argentina, burkina faso and trinidad. an official french government account said the united states was once a beacon of human rights and now stands isolated.

topics.headline: First US citizen charged over duress password after phone wiped at border
topics.snippet: Samuel Tunick, an American citizen, is being prosecuted after giving Customs and Border Protection agents a passcode that wiped his phone when entered. Agents stopped him on return from a trip abroad…
topics.text:
first us citizen charged over duress password after phone wiped at border
samuel tunick, an american citizen, is being prosecuted after giving customs and border protection agents a passcode that wiped his phone when entered. agents stopped him on return from a trip abroad and demanded he unlock the device without a warrant, telling him he had not yet formally entered the country. he had been under investigation over activism opposing the cop city project in atlanta. it is reported as the first us criminal case involving the use of a duress password.

topics.headline: Georgia police supervisor charged with using Flock cameras to track partner
topics.snippet: Page Fort, a police supervisor in Conyers, Georgia, was arrested after an internal audit of the department's Flock automated license plate reader program. The Georgia Bureau of Investigation says she…
topics.text:
georgia police supervisor charged with using flock cameras to track partner
page fort, a police supervisor in conyers, georgia, was arrested after an internal audit of the department's flock automated license plate reader program. the georgia bureau of investigation says she accessed the system for non-law-enforcement purposes more than 30 times between april and july of this year to search for her domestic partner's vehicle. she has been charged with prohibited use of law enforcement retained license plate data, and the investigation continues.

topics.headline: Utah campaign lays out a playbook for blocking data center projects
topics.snippet: An environmental advocate involved in opposing a hyperscale data center in Utah described tactics for contesting such projects, arguing the target is the approval process rather than the facility itse…
topics.text:
utah campaign lays out a playbook for blocking data center projects
an environmental advocate involved in opposing a hyperscale data center in utah described tactics for contesting such projects, arguing the target is the approval process rather than the facility itself. the utah project was advanced through a quasi-state authority that bypassed a local vote. recommended steps include tracking utility interconnection requests and planning commission agendas, seeking six-month or one-year moratoriums on construction or tax breaks, filing objections during federal air permit comment windows, and protesting water rights. more than a hundred communities have adopted moratoriums, and the utah state senate president who backed the project lost his primary.

topics.headline: Trump posts 2028 campaign material days after outlets called third term talk a joke
topics.snippet: Following remarks at a rescheduled White House Correspondents Dinner, outlets including TMZ, The Guardian and CNN reported that Trump was joking about running again in 2028. Two days later he posted 2…
topics.text:
trump posts 2028 campaign material days after outlets called third term talk a joke
following remarks at a rescheduled white house correspondents dinner, outlets including tmz, the guardian and cnn reported that trump was joking about running again in 2028. two days later he posted 2028 campaign material on truth social. steve bannon has previously said publicly that trump will be president in 2028 and that alternatives to the 22nd amendment's term limit would be laid out at an appropriate time.

topics.headline: Timeline links ICE funding law, FEC firings and National Guard deployment through 2029
topics.snippet: A sequence of recent measures was set out: on 10 June 2026 Trump signed a $70 billion immigration act funding ICE through 2029; on 10 July he dismissed the Federal Election Commission and the White Ho…
topics.text:
timeline links ice funding law, fec firings and national guard deployment through 2029
a sequence of recent measures was set out: on 10 june 2026 trump signed a $70 billion immigration act funding ice through 2029; on 10 july he dismissed the federal election commission and the white house fortified its front entrance; and on 15 july the department of defense ordered national guard troops deployed in washington dc through the 2029 inauguration, with housing provided in the city. these were placed alongside statements from stephen miller and other administration officials asserting broad discretion for ice agents, and the increasing presence of ice personnel at public events and airports.

topics.headline: Ukraine reported to have targeted Iranian vessels as regional conflicts overlap
topics.snippet: President Zelensky confirmed that Ukrainian forces struck or attempted to strike Iranian vessels, though details remain unclear. The development sits alongside the ongoing Russia-Ukraine war and the U…
topics.text:
ukraine reported to have targeted iranian vessels as regional conflicts overlap
president zelensky confirmed that ukrainian forces struck or attempted to strike iranian vessels, though details remain unclear. the development sits alongside the ongoing russia-ukraine war and the us and israeli campaign against iran, raising questions about whether separate conflicts are converging.

topics.headline: Rally planned at Utah Capitol to defend Bears Ears and Grand Staircase-Escalante
topics.snippet: A round dance rally in support of protecting the Bears Ears and Grand Staircase-Escalante national monuments is scheduled for Saturday, 1 August from 2:30pm on the south steps of the Utah State Capito…
topics.text:
rally planned at utah capitol to defend bears ears and grand staircase-escalante
a round dance rally in support of protecting the bears ears and grand staircase-escalante national monuments is scheduled for saturday, 1 august from 2:30pm on the south steps of the utah state capitol in salt lake city. organisers describe it as an indigenous-led effort intended to demonstrate to utah legislators and the administration that native voices and public interest will not be excluded from decisions on the monuments. the event is supported by green latinos, which helped secure the permit. attendees are advised to prepare for temperatures above 100°f.
